source_relationship: The restricted-dominator closure assertion is reconstructed by projection to ordered lower models, disjoint contact pieces and fixed-reference dominated closure.

The equation statement is derived here for L1 data against any fixed finite non-pluripolar measure and full relative classes; Corollary 6.2 states only the uniformly Lp bounded smooth-volume ordinary-type case.

The fixed-class Proposition 4.3 proof extremizes over reference masses; the book instead uses the existing fixed-dominator closure after projection, avoiding that step.
